title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1999 1.7.3 During the last 4 years (from 1996 to 1999), the share of Kidnapping & Abduction (from 1.2% to 1.3), Cheating (from 1.8% to 2.3%), Hurt (12.0% to 13.4%), Molestation (1.6% to 1.8%), Cruelty by Husband or Relatives (from 1.7% to 2.5%) and Sexual Harassment from (0.3% to 0.5%) registered an increasing trend. The share of cases under Burglary, Robbery, Theft and Riots had shown declining trend. The above trend signifies that there is a clear steady trend in Violent crimes and declining trend in Property and Economic Crimes in the country.
